description: Search Shellui tools with a short phrase. Returns compact matches: name, a one-line description, and read_only, destructive, and needs_approval. Use ai_describe_tool for the argument names. Optional filters: service (identity, storage, hosting, email) and access (read or write). limit defaults to 8. Then call the tool, or pass it to ai_call_tool.

access.description: Optional. read keeps read-only tools. write keeps tools that change data.

limit.description: How many matches to return. Default 8, maximum 20.

query.description: What you want to do, or an exact tool name.

service.description: Optional service id: identity, storage, hosting, email, or saas.

name: ai_search_tools
title: AI: Search tools

description: Return a trimmed input schema and access flags for one or more Shellui tool names. Arguments are named fields such as event_type or email. Do not pass HTTP method or path. Then call the tool directly or through ai_call_tool.

name.description: One tool name. Use names when you need more than one.

names.description: Gateway tool names, for example identity_list_users.

name: ai_describe_tool
title: AI: Describe tool

description: Run any Shellui gateway tool by name. arguments are named fields from ai_describe_tool, not HTTP method or path. Tenant scope, approvals, secret masking, and audit logging are identical to a direct call. In ask mode the person sees the real tool name and arguments, not ai_call_tool.

arguments.description: Arguments for that tool. Use the input schema from search or describe.

name.description: Gateway tool name, for example identity_create_invitations.

name: ai_call_tool
title: AI: Call tool

description: Read one Shellui approval without running the tool. Pass the approval_id from a pending tool result. Prefer a single call with Accept text/event-stream: while pending, the response holds as SSE until approved, denied, expired, or the wait times out. JSON-only callers get a one-shot status. When status is approved, call the original tool again with the same arguments. That runs it once.

approval_id.description: Approval id from a pending tool result.

name: ai_get_approval
title: AI: Approval status
